role: Read-only quarterly oil futures curve for the monthly game. It does not write back macro or commodity owners and does not create positions or orders.

spot_reference_price_usd.note: Current visible oil monthly close; reference only.

futures_price_usd.note: Model settlement reference for one quarterly expiry.

months_to_expiry.note: Zero means the contract expires in the current month.

monthly.note: Forward ratio-linked front-quarter OHLC through the requested cutoff. It is a non-tradable display index.

invariants: exactly five quarterly contracts are listed
the first expiry is the current or next March, June, September, or December
an expiry-month contract converges to the visible spot reference
advancing past quarter end removes the expired contract and appends one new far contract
pricing reads the current visible oil close, previous visible closes, and the latest completed annual macro row only
no future monthly close or later annual row is read for the requested cutoff
no write-back to global macro or commodity overlay
no orders, positions, margin, or mark-to-market in v0.1.0
